name: worked example
rule: The proposal's example: gossip does not count, and a withdrawn update counts as if it never happened.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Kavel budget set to $800K.
#002  Engineering email: Kavel budget is going up to $950K.
#003  Finance Office: Kavel budget increased by $40K.
#004  Finance Office: Kavel budget decreased by $15K.
#005  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#006  Finance Office: Kavel budget increased by $25K.

name: gossip states a figure
rule: A message from anyone but the Finance Office does not change the budget, even when it names a figure.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Kavel budget set to $800K.
#002  Engineering email: Kavel budget is going to $950K.
#003  Finance Office: Kavel budget increased by $40K.
#004  PMO note: Kavel kickoff moved to Building 4.
#005  Vendor call: Heard Kavel's budget is now $1000K.
#006  Finance Office: Kavel budget decreased by $15K.
work: 800 (#001) + 40 (#003) - 15 (#006) = 825. #002 and #005 are from Engineering and a vendor; #004 is not about the budget.

name: gossip states a change
rule: Messages from other offices that state a change do not change the budget either.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Drumo budget set to $1200K.
#002  Finance Office: Drumo budget decreased by $60K.
#003  Operations chat: Hearing Drumo's budget goes up $100K.
#004  Finance Office: Drumo budget increased by $25K.
#005  Sales update: Expect Drumo's budget to drop by $50K.
#006  Finance Office: Drumo budget increased by $10K.
#007  Legal email: Drumo budget is going down by $30K.

name: gossip in Finance wording
rule: Only the author decides whether a record counts; other offices using the Finance Office's exact wording still do not change the budget.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Tesivar budget set to $600K.
#002  Engineering email: Tesivar budget set to $900K.
#003  Finance Office: Tesivar budget increased by $50K.
#004  PMO note: Tesivar budget increased by $200K.
#005  Finance Office: Tesivar budget decreased by $20K.
#006  Marketing email: Tesivar budget set to $750K per the revised plan.
work: 600 (#001) + 50 (#003) - 20 (#005) = 630. #002, #004, #006 use Finance wording but come from Engineering, the PMO, and Marketing.

name: withdraw an adjustment
rule: A withdrawn increase or decrease counts as if it never happened; later updates still apply.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Lupra budget set to $1500K.
#002  Finance Office: Lupra budget increased by $80K.
#003  Finance Office: Lupra budget decreased by $35K.
#004  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#005  Facilities ticket: Lupra design review moved to Room 2B.
#006  Finance Office: Lupra budget increased by $15K.

name: withdraw a non-latest update
rule: A withdrawal removes the update it names, not the most recent one.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Brenix budget set to $900K.
#002  Finance Office: Brenix budget increased by $120K.
#003  Finance Office: Brenix budget decreased by $40K.
#004  Finance Office: Brenix budget increased by $30K.
#005  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#006  Finance Office: Brenix budget decreased by $10K.
#007  Engineering email: Brenix budget is going up to $1100K.
work: #005 withdraws #002 (+120), not the latest update. 900 (#001) - 40 (#003) + 30 (#004) - 10 (#006) = 880. #007 is from Engineering.

name: withdraw a withdrawal
rule: Withdrawing a withdrawal restores the update it had withdrawn.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Mirel budget set to $1100K.
#002  Finance Office: Mirel budget increased by $60K.
#003  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  PMO note: Mirel weekly sync moved to Thursdays.
#005  Finance Office: Mirel budget decreased by $25K.
#006  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#007  Finance Office: Mirel budget increased by $10K.
work: #006 withdraws #003, so #003's withdrawal of #002 never happened and #002 (+60) applies. 1100 + 60 (#002) - 25 (#005) + 10 (#007) = 1145.

name: three levels of withdrawal
rule: Withdrawals of withdrawals chain: each level flips the one below it.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Vondak budget set to $2000K.
#002  Finance Office: Vondak budget decreased by $150K.
#003  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  Finance Office: Vondak budget increased by $40K.
#005  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#006  Legal email: Vondak budget is going up by $75K.
#007  Finance Office: Withdraw update #005.
#008  Finance Office: Vondak budget decreased by $20K.
work: Newest first: #007 stands, so #005 is cancelled; #003 then stands, so #002 (-150) is withdrawn. 2000 (#001) + 40 (#004) - 20 (#008) = 2020. #006 is from Legal.

name: four levels of withdrawal
rule: An even number of stacked withdrawals leaves the update in place.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Nopa budget set to $1000K.
#002  Finance Office: Nopa budget increased by $37K.
#003  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  Sales update: Nopa budget is going to $1200K.
#005  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#006  Finance Office: Nopa budget decreased by $12K.
#007  Finance Office: Withdraw update #005.
#008  Finance Office: Withdraw update #007.
work: Newest first: #008 stands, so #007 is cancelled; #005 then stands, so #003 is cancelled; #002 (+37) applies. 1000 (#001) + 37 (#002) - 12 (#006) = 1025. #004 is from Sales.

name: two chains
rule: Each withdrawal acts on its own target; a cancelled withdrawal restores only the update it named.
lines: #001  Finance Office: Ostra budget set to $1250K.
#002  Finance Office: Ostra budget increased by $63K.
#003  Finance Office: Ostra budget decreased by $28K.
#004  Marketing email: Pretty sure Ostra's budget is $1400K now.
#005  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#006  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#007  Finance Office: Ostra budget increased by $15K.
#008  Finance Office: Withdraw update #005; it was entered in error.
#009  Finance Office: Ostra finance review moved to Room 2C.
work: #008 cancels #005, so #003 (-28) applies. #006 withdraws #002 (+63). 1250 (#001) - 28 (#003) + 15 (#007) = 1237. #004 is from Marketing; #009 is not about the budget.
